evidence_items.locator: Appendix, introduction to Model evaluation scores
evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI ties the larger pretraining run to gains: its table reports GPQA scores of 71.4% versus 53.6% for GPT-4o and AIME 2024 scores of 36.7% versus 9.3%. These are company-reported comparisons; the release also acknowledges architectural and optimization changes.

The footnote compares GPT-4.5's gains over GPT-4o on GPQA and Math Level 5 with observed performance-versus-compute trends. This is later analysis of the February model generation, not evidence from a later model.

unresolved_gaps: Public evidence does not isolate model size, data quantity, architecture, and training improvements in a controlled frontier-scale experiment.
The evidence does not settle whether the gains justified their additional cost.
